title: Acana Sachet Moth Killer 16 Pack- For Drawers & Storage- Protects Clothing & Bedding- Lasts 3 Months

Protects all clothing and bedding, including woollens, cashmere, linens, furs, leathers & silks. Light Lavender fragrance, with natural oils

EACH SACHET LASTS 3 MONTHS. Uses the latest technologies in Moth Killing & Fragrancing. Effectively kills moths, their eggs and larvae safely. Each sachet is individually Foil Sealed and lasts for up to 3 months in use
